the GFDL CGCM reproduces the fundamental characteristics of the Indian Ocean climate, including the IODZMs, and that the IODZMS and El Nino have similar Indo- Pacific warm- pool anomaly patterns, suggesting that they are related.
the GFDL CGCM reproduces well the observed IOD/ IODZM variability, and that the IODZMs can be triggered without an El Nino event, but they are likely more common when the El Nino is present.

the CGCM is a promising tool for the study of the Indian Ocean climate and its interactions with the climate of the other ocean basins, and that it provides a valuable framework for further investigation of the IOD and its relationship with El Nino.

the GFDL CGCM is able to capture the essential characteristics of the Indian Ocean climate system, including the IODZMs, and that the IODZMS and El Nino share a common Indo- Pacific warm- pool- related dynamical basis.
the CGCM can simulate the IODZMs, including the co- occurrence with El Nino events and the decadal modulation of their occurrence.
